requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:74 create() passes no slug to CreateQueue (empty trailing arg) after computing an unused $slug; Queues.php:117 rename() also omits the re-derived slug; resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:17 is only a list plus '<!-- Create Modal Placeholder -->' (no create/detail/rename/toggle/access modal); resources/views/livewire/entity/serve.blade.php:11 wires selection as 'wire:click="selectedQueueId={{ $queue->id }}"' and renders no mode selector, waiting list or ui.serve_empty state; app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:53 'Simplified: no access grants logic implemented.'; no navbar change was included at all.

conventions.evidence: Actions are reused and lang keys added in both locales, but there are no tests (conventions.md:12-21 requires test-first for everything), renameName is validated via validateOnly without any #[Validate] rule (Queues.php:114), record IDs lack #[Locked] (Queues.php:34-39), no per-action $this->authorize (Livewire policy rule 3), and no docs/CHANGELOG updates (conventions.md:92-103).

security.evidence: Scoped resolution is mostly correct (Queues.php:111,141,166,177,189-198; Serve.php:77,97 uses entity->queues()), and Blade uses {{ }}; however confirmToggle() assigns a client id to viewingQueueId without scoping (Queues.php:129-131), 'mode' is unvalidated and fed to CallMode::from() (Serve.php:102), lastCalledTicketId is client-writable (Serve.php:32), mount passes the entity as an ignored third arg to authorize (Queues.php:37), and no action re-authorizes server-side.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files at all (only app/, resources/views/, lang/, routes/web.php); conventions require happy-path, unauthorized-call and tamper tests for every Livewire action.

simplicity.evidence: Small components that reuse CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess and CallNextTicket (Queues.php:100,143,168,191,198; Serve.php:104) with no speculative layers, but there is dead code ($slug unused at Queues.php:75, placeholder comments at queues.blade.php:17 and Serve.php:53) and duplicated try/catch + scoped lookup blocks.

readability.evidence: Methods are short, but the code reads as unfinished: unused imports (Queues.php:10,12,16,17; Serve.php:12,16), one-line 'if (...) return;' (Queues.php:113,139), dangling empty call arguments (Queues.php:74-76,117-119), placeholder comments, missing trailing newlines in both Blade files, and 'App\Livewire\Entity\Queues::class' in routes/web.php:57-58 instead of the sibling import style.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: two Livewire components, two views, lang additions in lang/en/ui.php:88-106 and lang/pt_BR/ui.php:88-106, member tabs in app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:25 and resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:6-15, and two routes in routes/web.php:57-58; no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: create() calls CreateQueue with the slug argument left empty (trailing comma) after computing $slug and never using it, so queue creation either raises ArgumentCountError/500 or fails to derive the slug as the contract requires.
rename() calls UpdateQueue with the same empty trailing argument, so the slug is never re-derived from the new name ("Old" -> "New" must yield "new") and the rename requirement is unmet.

The queues view only renders the list; the create modal, detail modal, rename form, toggle confirmation modal and access modal are all absent (there is literally a '<!-- Create Modal Placeholder -->'), so none of the required UI is reachable.

callableQueues()/waitingTickets() declare an Eloquent\Collection return type but return collect() (an Illuminate\Support\Collection), which throws a TypeError; the serve page 500s for employees and when no queue is selected.
"wire:click=\"selectedQueueId={{ $queue->id }}\"" is not valid Livewire syntax (property writes need $set('selectedQueueId', id)), so selecting a queue errors instead of updating state.

waitingTickets() filters neither by the selected mode nor by waiting status, and does not check the user's call permission; the view never renders the waiting list, priority/issue time, translated channel or the ui.serve_empty empty state.

Access-grant logic is explicitly skipped ('Simplified: no access grants logic implemented.'), so employees without manager roles can never see or call any queue, violating the callable-queues selector requirement.
Navigation was not touched at all, so ui.nav_queues and ui.nav_serve keys are added but the required navbar dropdown entries and manager-only visibility are missing.

confirmToggle() assigns the client-supplied $id to viewingQueueId without resolving it through entity->queues(), violating the rule that every client id must be scoped/validated and that the confirmation targets the queue being viewed.
The public $mode has no #[Validate] rule (nor an allow-list check) and is passed to CallMode::from(), so a tampered mode string raises an uncaught ValueError and 500s the request.
lastCalledTicketId is documented as not client-writable but is a plain public property, and the queue/toggle/access ids lack #[Locked], contrary to the Livewire policy for server-only state.

The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, so there is no coverage of the happy path, the unauthorized-call case for each action, or tamper attempts, which the project's mandatory TDD and Livewire rules require.

No public action (create, rename, toggleActive, openAccess, grantAccess, revokeAccess) calls $this->authorize after resolving its model; only mount does, which skips the required per-action server-side authorization.

mount() calls authorize('create', Queue::class, $entity) but Livewire's authorize() takes only ($ability, $arguments), so the entity is silently dropped and the policy is checked without the entity context it needs.
The rate-limit notice uses __('ui.serve_rate_limited'), a key that exists in neither lang/en/ui.php nor lang/pt_BR/ui.php, so users would see the raw key.
accessGrants returns every membership instead of the queue's grants, so the access modal cannot distinguish managers-without-grant from granted members as required.
A foreign/unknown selected queue is caught and turned into an empty notice instead of letting the scoped findOrFail raise not-found as the task specifies.
No CHANGELOG or docs update accompanies a new feature, contrary to the project's keep-docs-in-sync rule.
Several imports are unused (User, EntityMembership, Log, RateLimiter on Queues) and dead/placeholder comments remain, making the components look unfinished.
The section aria-label calls __('ui.queues_title') without the :entity replacement, so it announces the literal text "Queues of :entity".
Interactive row and call-next buttons have no aria-label, although the task requires accessible labels on interactive controls.
Both new Blade files end without a trailing newline, and Queues.php uses single-line guard statements, diverging from sibling style.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues and Serve Livewire components, their views, lang keys, routes and members tabs, but it is a skeleton: queue create/rename call the actions without the derived slug, the queues view has no modals, the serve view has no waiting list or working queue selection, and employee access grants are explicitly not implemented. It also ships no tests, lacks per-action authorization and locking, and returns the wrong collection type; it needs substantial rework before it could be approved.
